verdict.rationale: Square's own SDK and MCP server document date-based API version pinning: the Node SDK accepts a per-request `version: "2024-05-04"` override, and the MCP server supports SQUARE_VERSION pinning. That evidences versioned APIs, but nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, such as timelines, sunset notices or support windows. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/retirement policy, first-party versioning docs (release notes, changelog, version lifecycle), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
